page.overview:
Who is Olivier Grouillard?

Olivier Grouillard (born September 2, 1958) is a retired French Formula One driver who competed in the sport between 1989 and 1992, driving for and , amongst others.

Grouillard made his Formula One debut at the age of 30. He scored his first and only point in his Formula One career at his home race.

Grouillard joined the team meanwhile Nicola Larini moved to .

Grouillard remained with the team under the name. After the Portuguese Grand Prix, he was sacked by Osella's team boss Gabriele Rumi. After being sacked, he joned the team at the next race, but the team closed its doors.
